section: Kisan movements in Andhra - Munagala, Challapalli and other struggles

accepted.s: The Union Cabinet extended the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme up to which financial year?
accepted.x: The Union Cabinet extended PM-KISAN up to 2030–31.
accepted.tq: Use the exact terminal year to distinguish closely spaced policy periods.

accepted.s: What outlay was provided for the extended period of the PM-KISAN scheme?
accepted.x: The extended PM-KISAN scheme has an outlay of Rs 3.15 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise financial figure rather than relying on approximate magnitude.

accepted.s: Under PM-KISAN, eligible farmers continue to receive annually:
accepted.x: PM-KISAN provides Rs 6,000 per year to eligible farmers in three instalments.
accepted.tq: Separate the scheme’s central annual benefit from state-level supplementary assistance.

accepted.s: In May 2026, the first 2026 kharif instalment under Annadata Sukhibhava, in conjunction with PM-KISAN, was paid in Andhra Pradesh at the rate of:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh paid Rs 7,000 per farmer as the first 2026 kharif instalment under Annadata Sukhibhava with PM-KISAN.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the state-linked payment from the standard PM-KISAN annual amount.

accepted.s: Approximately how many farmers received the first 2026 kharif instalment under Annadata Sukhibhava with PM-KISAN in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The payment was made to 46.85 lakh farmers in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Read the decimal figure carefully when numerical options differ by a constant interval.

accepted.s: The All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) protested police action at Hansi in:
accepted.x: AIKS protested police action at Hansi, Haryana, on 16 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the organisation with the specific location of its reported activity.

accepted.s: On which date did the AIKS protest police action at Hansi, Haryana?
accepted.x: The protest at Hansi, Haryana, was reported on 16 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between nearby dates associated with different contemporary developments.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the demands associated with peasant movements in Andhra:
1. Demand for Minimum Support Price was included.
2. Demand for minimum wages was included.
3. Abolition of zamindari was demanded.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The demands included MSP, minimum wages and zamindari abolition; therefore, all three statements are correct.
accepted.tq: Check whether all items belong to the same demand cluster before selecting the complete combination.

accepted.s: N. G. Ranga’s memorandum to the Whitley Commission in 1929 primarily reflected the demand for:
accepted.x: N. G. Ranga’s 1929 memorandum to the Whitley Commission raised the demand for minimum wages.
accepted.tq: Link the document, year and demand instead of confusing it with other agrarian demands.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: Nidubrolu — India’s first peasant training institute
Hansi — First peasant training institute in India
Nidubrolu — Place of the Whitley Commission in 1929
accepted.x: Nidubrolu was India’s first peasant training institute. The Whitley Commission memorandum was associated with N. G. Ranga in 1929, while Hansi and Mandasa refer to other developments.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure place–institution pair and eliminate the swapped associations.

accepted.s: Who died in jail after the Mandasa protest?
o: A leader of the AIKS at Hansi
accepted.x: Pulleti Shyamasundara Rao died in jail after the Mandasa protest.
accepted.tq: Match the individual with the specific consequence and event rather than with a similar agrarian association.
